description: Source code for a video recording utility in Android, including a DummySource class for generating test video frames, command-line argument parsing, and media encoding setup using Android's stagefright framework.

classes.name: DummySource
classes.description: A media source generating dummy video frames for testing purposes.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the video recording utility.

methods.name: DummySource::getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format metadata of the dummy video source.

methods.name: DummySource::start
methods.description: Initializes the dummy source for frame generation.

methods.name: DummySource::read
methods.description: Generates and provides a dummy video frame buffer.

methods.name: translateColorToOmxEnumValue
methods.description: Converts a color format code to an OMX color format enum value.
